turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
140 students. One of them is mine, and he has a zero. On what basis?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then show me what you have.
